DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome (likely Membranous Nephropathy) with secondary right upper lobe pneumonia.

The labs show severe hypoalbuminemia, massive proteinuria (4+), and hyperlipidemia, which confirms nephrotic syndrome.
